scope: Document local data locations, export/deletion/retention/backup/recovery, supported profiles and maintenance/dependency policy. No required hosted subscription, paid core feature or unearned SLA (Requirement N38).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C38-owned implementation, test, fixture, and documentation paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own binary SHA-256. Excludes plans/, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, status-only START_HERE/DEFINITION_OF_DONE and docs/evidence/C38.json to avoid recursive self-reference. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)

hardware.required_profile: 4 vCPU / 8192 MiB RAM / 20480 MiB free disk

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C38 service policy, storage lifecycle, profile limits, and maintenance contract fixture; contains no real credential, provider state or plaintext secret.

results.acceptance: Document local data locations, export/deletion/retention/backup/recovery, supported profiles and maintenance/dependency policy. No required hosted subscription, paid core feature or unearned SLA.

invariants_verified.local_first_custody: Enforced; runtime state contained in .local-data/ without external cloud storage dependencies.
invariants_verified.atomic_manifest_publication: Enforced; crashed or interrupted writers leave authoritative prior manifest intact and orphan staging bytes are reclaimed on open.
invariants_verified.replay_idempotency: Enforced; replayed operations with duplicate operation_ids produce idempotent responses without redundant manifest revisions.
invariants_verified.quota_bounds_enforcement: Enforced; payload writes exceeding 1 MiB or depth limits fail closed.
invariants_verified.provider_ownership: Enforced; OpenBao owns sealed secret bytes and zero plaintext sentinels are written to engine metadata storage.
invariants_verified.zero_unearned_sla: Enforced; service policy explicitly rejects commercial cloud uptime SLAs, grounding durability in local code invariants.
